description: NovaGuard is passionate about exploring innovative solutions for astronaut health monitoring and space exploration. We aim to leverage AI, data analytics, and software development to support astronaut well-being during space missions. We welcome collaborators interested in AI/ML, healthcare technology, data science, frontend development, and backend development who want to build impactful solutions for the future of space exploration.

details:
NovaGuard – AI-Assisted Astronaut Health Monitoring

NovaGuard is an astronaut health-monitoring platform designed to support astronaut well-being and mission safety during long-duration space missions. It brings important health information into a unified, mission-oriented dashboard, helping astronauts monitor their condition and understand changes in their health data.

The platform is designed to organize physiological measurements such as heart rate, oxygen saturation, body temperature, sleep duration, water intake, and exercise duration. Mission-aware health records, historical trends, symptom tracking, daily wellness checklists, and health-assessment summaries help users review their health information over time. An interactive 2D human-body interface provides a visual way to explore health-related information.

NovaGuard also includes the concept of Microgravity Emergency Clinical Playbooks for five spaceflight emergency scenarios: kidney stones, lunar dust eye abrasions, toxic ammonia ingress, severe space motion sickness, and decompression sickness. These playbooks are intended to support structured checklists and medical inventory lookup. A Cumulative Radiation Dosimeter and Solar Particle Event Monitor is designed to visualize radiation exposure against configured reference thresholds and demonstrate emergency workflows, including shelter-retreat and EVA-abort tasks. Simulated events are distinguished from actual measurements.

The main benefit of NovaGuard is to make astronaut health information easier to understand and organize, while supporting timely human assessment and coordinated responses. Its intended impact is to contribute to safer space missions by improving health-data visibility, wellness tracking, and preparedness for medical or radiation-related events.

The project is being developed using Python, FastAPI, React, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase PostgreSQL. The backend uses SQLAlchemy and Alembic for database modelling and migrations. The software architecture separates the user interface, API, and database to support maintainability and future expansion.

NovaGuard’s creative approach is its combination of health monitoring, an interactive body-based interface, mission-day checklists, emergency playbooks, and radiation-event visualization in one platform. The design considers the constraints of space missions, including limited access to immediate medical support, the importance of clear information, usability under demanding conditions, data privacy, and the need for human oversight. NovaGuard is intended as a decision-support prototype, not a replacement for professional medical judgment or a clinically validated flight system.
